report.answer_text:
Season 2 of *Just Add Magic* has already been released, and it came out in two parts on Amazon Prime Video:
Part 1: The first episode, "Just Add Halloween," aired Oct 14, 2016.[1] The rest of the first 13 episodes of the season were released on January 12, 2017[2].
Part 2: The remaining episodes (14–26 overall) were released on January 19, 2018[2].
One thing may cause confusion. Some articles say season 2 premiered on January 13. That date comes from Amazon's announcement for the second half of the season. That announcement describes the plot as the girls' Last-Ditch Layer Cake breaking every spell in town, which brings back an old enemy, Chuck Hankins.[3]
The series ran until 2020, and a follow-up series, *Just Add Magic: Mystery City*, was released on January 17, 2020.[4] You can stream seasons 1–4 on Prime Video[5].
